title: 第11章 各方云集第12章 狒王之争
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 收取古岩暴蜥尸骸，夜玄折返回黑晶矿洞。
注视由斩夜螳螂尸骸堆积而成的高耸尸山，夜狩虫瞳闪过贪欲，嘴角分泌出缕缕粘稠口水。
吃！
吃掉这些同族，自己定能发生不可思议异变！
“去吃。”
心意相通，夜玄笑着下达命令。
黑光一闪，夜狩来到尸堆边低首疯狂进食。
它宛若饥饿数天的牢中困兽，又或许是天生对同族血肉充满渴望，张嘴用力一扯一撕碎，同族脊背甲壳轻松破碎，露出肥美血肉…
“夜玄，树秀于林风必摧之，新的天赋不要擅自暴露。”
黑姬声音慵懒，给出提醒。
“道理我懂，除非遇到生命危险，我定不会当众使用。”
夜玄眼皮一翻，开始于洞窟内采集黑晶肉芽草。
黑晶肉芽草，一阶魔植，拇指大小，模样类似剥去指甲盖的手指。
此魔植价值昂贵，甲壳类妖兽吞服，具有缓慢增长甲壳厚度，从而达到加强甲壳防御的功效。
市场上，能轻松卖到百枚兽币。
夜玄四处翻找，就连隐蔽的边角石缝也未曾放过。
毕竟，这可都是难得的资源啊。
不一会儿，夜玄足足收集到百枚黑晶肉芽草。
换算下来，价值万枚兽币。
兽币，各大人族都城通用货币，万枚兽币，足以于妖宠市场买到一只不错的精英级妖宠。
“可以，足够夜狩进食一阵。”
夜玄面露笑意，脱下身上麻衣裹住众多肉芽草。
御兽之道，内有乾坤。
妖兽并非不知疲乏机器，也需进食，与人一样，其中以肉食妖兽饲养费方面最为昂贵。
如某些大型妖兽，一顿都要进食百斤血肉。
各中花销可见恐怖。
除去普通喂食饲养，还需进行魔植饲养。
以黑晶肉芽草为例，长期食用此物的斩夜螳螂，与普通个体之间会产生显著差异。
前者在体魄强度、战斗本能等方面都远胜后者。
差距，会随着时间推移愈发明显，最终形成天壤之别——这就是魔植饲养。
当然，魔植饲养很费兽币就是…
收拾完毕，见夜狩疯狂进食同族，丝毫没有停嘴打算，夜玄慢悠悠于洞窟内闲逛。
矿石洞窟内，仍有不少弱小的普通级妖兽。

Collecting the remains of the ancient rock lizard, Ye Xuan returned to the black crystal mine.
Gazing at the towering mountain of corpses piled up from the corpses of the Night-Slaying Mantis, greed flashed through Ye Shou's eyes, and strands of sticky saliva secreted from the corners of his mouth.
eat!
If you eat these people of the same race, you will definitely undergo incredible changes!
"Go and eat."
Connected with each other, Ye Xuan smiled and gave the order.
“Whoosh!
! "
With a flash of black light, Ye Shou came to the pile of corpses, lowered his head and ate frantically.
It was like a trapped animal that had been starving for days, or maybe it was born with a thirst for the flesh and blood of its own race. It opened its mouth and tore it apart with force, and the carapace on its back was easily broken, revealing the plump flesh and blood...
"Ye Xuan, if a tree is as beautiful as the forest wind, it will be destroyed. Don't expose your new talent without permission."
Heiji's voice was lazy and she gave a reminder.
"I understand the truth. Unless my life is in danger, I will never use it in public."
Ye Xuan rolled his eyelids and began to collect black crystal granulation grass in the cave.
Black Crystal Granulation Grass, a first-order magic plant, is about the size of a thumb, and looks like a finger with its fingernails peeled off.
This magical plant is very valuable and can be swallowed by crustacean monsters. It can slowly increase the thickness of the carapace, thus achieving the effect of strengthening the carapace defense.
In the market, one can easily sell hundreds of beast coins.
Ye Xuan searched everywhere, even the hidden corners and crevices of the rocks.
After all, these are rare resources.
After a while, Ye Xuan collected a hundred pieces of black crystal granulation grass.
Converted, it's worth ten thousand beast coins.
Beast coins are the common currency in all major human capitals. Ten thousand beast coins are enough to buy a good elite-level demon pet in the demon pet market.
"Okay, enough for night hunting to feed for a while."
With a smile on his face, Ye Xuan took off his linen clothes and wrapped them in numerous granules.
There is a universe within the way to control beasts.
Monsters are not tireless machines. They also need to eat, just like humans. Among them, carnivorous monsters are the most expensive to raise.
For example, some large monsters can eat hundreds of kilograms of flesh and blood in one meal.
The expenses in each area are horrific.
In addition to ordinary feeding and breeding, magic plant feeding is also required.
Taking black crystal granulation grass as an example, there will be a significant difference between a night-killing mantis that eats this substance for a long time and an ordinary individual.
The former is far superior to the latter in terms of physical strength and fighting instinct.
The gap will become more and more obvious as time goes by, eventually forming a world of difference - this is magic plant breeding.
Of course, raising magic plants costs a lot of beast coins...
After cleaning up, he saw that Ye Xuan was eating like crazy and had no intention of stopping. Ye Xuan slowly wandered around the cave.
There are still many weak ordinary-level monsters in the ore cave.
